treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of India and the Kingdom of Morocco for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (1998, as amended by Protocol 2013)
eif_quote: Whereas the annexed Convention between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Kingdom of Morocco ... has come into force on the 20th day of February, 2000 ... Notification : No. GSR 245(E), dated 15-3-2000.
source_title: Wayback copy (2013) of Income Tax Department of India (law.incometaxindia.gov.in) text of Notification GSR 245(E) dated 15-3-2000 with annexed India-Morocco Convention

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that Contracting State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties or fees for technical services may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties or the fees for technical services, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties or fees for technical services.

ppt.quote: Not MLI-covered: Morocco has signed but not ratified the MLI (per map.json); the 1998 Convention contains no principal purpose / limitation of benefits article.

notes: Effective dates (Art. 29(3)): India - income arising in fiscal years beginning on or after 1 April following the calendar year of entry into force (2000) -> 2001-04-01; Morocco - income arising on or after 1 January 2001 (valid_from uses the Indian-side date). Art. 11(3): interest exempt at source when derived and beneficially owned by the Government, political sub-division or local authority, and listed institutions (India: RBI, IFCI, IDBI, EXIM Bank, NHB, SIDBI, ICICI; Morocco: Bank Al-Maghrib, Northern Provinces Development Agency, Central Popular Bank, BNDE, BMCE, FEC, CIH, ODI) or other agreed institutions - not modelled. Art. 12 cap of 10% applies equally to fees for technical services (FTS not modelled). Amending Protocol signed New Delhi 8 August 2013 entered into force 15 July 2019 (India Notification No. 84/2019, S.O. 3789(E) dated 22-10-2019, read in a secondary reproduction on taxguru.in); it only replaces Art. 26 (Exchange of information) and does not change Arts. 10-12 (map.json listed it as N/A per the 2019 MLI positions; Morocco's MLI list gives 08-02-2013 - conflict on signature date). Morocco has signed but not ratified the MLI, so no MLI modification. Text read from an archived official Indian Income Tax Department page (live incometaxindia.gov.in returns 403).
unverified: 2013 Protocol content/entry into force read only from a secondary reproduction of Notification No. 84/2019 (not rate-relevant)
